summary: A friendly first app for Glaze.
description: Say hello to your Glaze. Tap the button and watch your count grow. Hello remembers every tap, even after you return Home.
Slide the numbered tiles into order, leaving the empty space at the bottom right. Every shuffled board can be solved. Your puzzle is saved after every move.

summary: A pocket canvas for bright ideas.
description: Draw with your stylus in six colors. Choose the eraser to tidy up, or Clear to start again. Your canvas is saved as you draw, ready whenever inspiration returns.

Clear the board without uncovering a mine. Tap to dig, hold to flag, and tap a satisfied number to clear its neighbors. Choose Beginner or Intermediate and beat your best time. Your game is saved after every move.

summary: Klondike on the go. Deal yourself in.
description: Build four foundations from ace to king in classic Klondike Solitaire. Choose draw one or draw three, drag cards or tap to move them, and undo a move when you need to. Your deal is saved after every move.
